scientific_assessment.reason: With the same local LLM and the same exploration floor, consulting the LLM once and learning from pooled outcomes did at least as well as asking the LLM at every step in all nine cells, and better on learning in all nine and on entrant precision in eight. The LLM agent ranked probe profiles well once evidence was public, but its probabilities rose well above the observed success rate, so it admitted too many agents and forecast poorly. It did not beat the hand rule in any cell.
